lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And what did you do with that, was that a Suzuki? And where did you push that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: He had it outside, I just pushed it into the garage.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: And what else was in that garage at that time?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: He had had moped in there? Anything else?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: No other vehicle? (PAUSE). Can you tell me some other things?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: You saw? Didn't see anything in that fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: What was in the garbage bags?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you help carry them out or?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Out of the house or garage?
